boundary_and_coefficients.g_equals_2r: At the ordinary seed the first score gap is g-2r; at g=2r it ties and sigma(1)=r-1=(g-2)/2 lies on the open height boundary. This is sharp only for the ordinary seed and chosen strict selected face.

carry_and_leading_forms.carried_p: A*1>1 and u_n>u_(n-1) imply A*u_n>A*u_(n-1)=v_n row by row.
carry_and_leading_forms.carried_q: C-I is entrywise positive, so B*A*u_n-u_n=(C-I)u_n>0.
carry_and_leading_forms.leading_form_survival: Strict degree uniqueness plus LH(fg)=LH(f)LH(g) != 0 in the polynomial domain; degree arithmetic or coefficient positivity alone is not a proof.
carry_and_leading_forms.recurrence: v_(n+1)=A*u_n and u_(n+1)=C*u_n for n>=0, with u_0=1.

cone_and_selectors.intermediate: For v=A*u, v_1/u_1=h and v_i/u_1=2+2sigma-x_i for 2<=i<=r.
cone_and_selectors.normalized_variables: x_i=u_i/u_1 only for 2<=i<=r; sigma=sum_{i=2}^r x_i and excludes x_1.

strict_cone_invariance.least_parameter: At h=2m+4 every decisive factor h-2m-3 equals 1.

frozen_theorem.field: K is an arbitrary field of characteristic zero; algebraic closedness is not assumed.

maps_and_geometry.symplecticity: The triangular Jacobian off-diagonal blocks are symmetric Hessians.

matrices_and_supports.A: A is M with row 1 replaced by h*e_1^T.
matrices_and_supports.B: B is M with row r replaced by h*e_r^T.
matrices_and_supports.C: C=B*A, never A*B; the phase order is S then T.
matrices_and_supports.competitive_rows: Exactly first V and last W rows compete; all other gradient rows are singletons.

frozen_theorem.parameters: Integers r>=4 and g>=2r+1; h=g-1 and m=r-2, hence m>=2 and h>=2m+4.

spectral_collapse.E: E={(a,b,...,b,c)^T}; (a,b,c) maps to exactly m equal middle coordinates.
spectral_collapse.U: U={z in K^r: z_1=z_r=0 and sum_{i=2}^{r-1}z_i=0}, dim U=r-3.

annihilating_recurrence.status: cubic annihilator only; no universal minimality or irreducibility

spectral_collapse.direct_sum: K^r=U direct-sum E in characteristic zero.
spectral_collapse.unit_multiplicity: Eigenvalue 1 has algebraic and geometric multiplicity exactly r-3; no quotient unit eigenvalue or hidden unit Jordan block.

visibility_and_degree.strict_visibility: The last q-coordinate strictly dominates all other q and p coordinate degrees only for n>=1.
